Reasoning: The sum of the interior angles of any quadrilateral is 360°. Therefore, x + x + (2x+5) + (2x+7) = 360. Combining like terms gives 6x + 12 = 360. Subtract 12: 6x = 348. Divide by 6: x = 58.
